text: Prednisone: A synthetic corticosteroid prodrug. It is biologically inert and must be converted by the liver into prednisolone to be effective.
Prednisolone: The active metabolite of prednisone. It is used directly in patients with hepatic failure as it requires no liver conversion.
Methylprednisolone: A similar corticosteroid, but with higher potency than prednisone.
Hydrocortisone: A mild corticosteroid used for skin inflammation and adrenal insufficiency.
Dexamethasone: A long-acting corticosteroid with very high potency and no mineralocorticoid activity.
